srk_cyclist.text: In Sark, everybody cycles. Bikes are hired at the harbour and ridden up the hill by anyone who thinks they'll manage. Mind the tractors, and the horses, and the cows. And the hill.
There are a few hundred people living on the whole island, and every one of them knows exactly which cyclist you are. You'll be waving at all of them.

srk_astronomer.text: Sark has no street lights at all. On a clear night you can see the Milky Way from the harbour. There's a star party here every year, and the cloud always arrives on the night.
The first Dark Sky Island in the world, we are. That sort of thing sticks in the islanders' throats. In a good way.

srk_dame.text: Dame Sibyl Hathaway was Dame of Sark from 1927 to 1974. During the Occupation she ran the island's dealings with the Germans, as the Dame of the island, for five very long years. It is a more complicated story than most.
Her roses are still in the garden. I tend them, with some fear.

srk_sailor.text: Back to St Peter Port? Right you are. The tide's with us, and so is the sunset.
